hero.titleLine1: A resume that gets past the bots
hero.subtitle: LocalATSCV helps you build a resume optimized for applicant tracking systems (ATS) and tailor it to every job in a few clicks. Everything happens in your browser: no account, no data sent anywhere

ats.title: Your resume is read by a machine first
ats.text: Most large companies and recruiting agencies sort applications with an ATS (Applicant Tracking System). It extracts the text of your resume, stores it in a database and lets recruiters search candidates by keyword

layout.title: Complex layouts
layout.text: Columns, tables and text boxes scramble the reading order: your information comes out jumbled

image.title: Unreadable text
image.text: Icons, skill gauges and some design-tool exports turn into gibberish characters, or no text at all

keywords.title: Missing keywords
keywords.text: If the job ad's vocabulary doesn't appear in your resume, your profile won't show up in recruiters' searches

ats.fix: LocalATSCV does the opposite: a single column, real text and standard section headings that bots read in the right order

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Question not listed here? Write to us:

ats.a: An Applicant Tracking System is the software recruiters use to receive, sort and search applications. It converts your resume to text and indexes it: if the text is badly extracted or the right keywords are missing, your application becomes hard to find

storage.a: Only in your browser, using IndexedDB, a database built into every modern browser. It never goes through our servers, which only know how to serve the application files

clear.q: What happens if I clear my browser data?
clear.a: Your resumes are erased, since they exist nowhere else. Export a JSON backup regularly: you can import it back at any time, on any device

score.q: Does the score guarantee my resume will be shortlisted?
score.a: No. Every ATS has its own rules and the final decision is made by a human. The score is an indicator: it checks that your resume uses the job ad's vocabulary and that a machine can read it correctly

photo.q: Why does the photo disappear in English?
photo.a: In the UK, the US and many English-speaking countries, photos and dates of birth are discouraged to limit hiring discrimination. Some recruiters even reject resumes that include them

free.a: Yes. LocalATSCV is an open source project under the MIT license, with no ads or subscription. It costs almost nothing to host, since your browser does all the work
